title: The dark screen at a sky's start
notes: Fixed: pressing New, Continue or Begin showed a dark screen for ten seconds or more. The phone was asked to draw painted videos before it had decoded a frame of them, while starting several at once; now each shows its still until a real frame arrives, they start one at a time, and the worlds screen plays one loop instead of four.
The tester trace records each painted video's first-frame time.
